title: Healthcare graduates most satisfied with choice of course, UK data shows
summary: Official agency’s figures indicate those who took journalism or marketing far more likely to regret their decision The 2026 league table View the full guide The UK’s most satisfied graduates are those who studied healthcare subjects, while those who opted for journalism or marketing are far more likely to regret their choices, according to data obtained by the Guardian. Vets, midwives and paramedics were the happiest with their degrees after entering the workforce, alongside those who studied vocational subjects such as architecture, computer science and construction, and were most likely to say they would study the same course if they were making their university choices again.
